summary: Trigger.dev: Prototype pollution via run metadata operations -> process-wide cross-tenant DoS

git.note: Official introduced 3.3.8 is early: package tag @trigger.dev/core@3.3.8 is the parent of intro squash 34f8bd588 and lacks operations.ts. First containing package tag is @trigger.dev/core@3.3.9. That is not a same-version vulnerable/patched contradiction. Released pair used here is v4.5.5 (sink, no guard) vs v4.5.6 (guard present).

scope_statement: PUT /api/v1/runs/:runId/metadata applies attacker-controlled operation.key through JSONHeroPath.set onto run metadata with no __proto__/constructor/prototype rejection, polluting Object.prototype in the shared webapp process.
ai_marker_evidence: Introducing squash 34f8bd588 (Eric Allam, PR #1563) and all 13 PR members have empty cve-analyzer detect_ai_signals. Member cf80a02d first adds packages/core/src/v3/runMetadata/operations.ts with JSONHeroPath(operation.key).set and has no AI trailer. CodeRabbit appears only as PR-body review HTML and as squash bullet 'Couple of fixes from CodeRabbit'; that is review branding, not an introducing hunk marker. Fix squash 6997aeb has no AI trailer. Proto-pollution member 0c2d9ce (Chris Arderne, 'respond to devin comments') also has empty detect_ai_signals. Claude Opus trailers on PR #4316 siblings 7cb35f12 / 677ce4cc / 7fd671a0 / dcc4b40d are other security fixes in the same batch, not this sink.
counterevidence: First-party identity closes, but the sink is authored by unmarked Eric Allam in January 2025. Removing Claude-marked sibling closers does not remove JSONHeroPath.set. Tag v4.5.5 still calls JSONHeroPath.set with no isSafeMetadataKey guard; tag v4.5.6 adds the guard via squash 6997aeb, which is an ancestor of v4.5.6 and not of v4.5.5. Member 0c2d9ce is not an ancestor of that squash; authorship is not transferred. Absent from the 212 leader-declared IDs and aliases.

identity_gate.reason: First-party repo advisory GHSA-p28v-f755-9qrg on triggerdotdev/trigger.dev is published and not withdrawn. Official github-reviewed JSON references https://github.com/triggerdotdev/trigger.dev/security/advisories/GHSA-p28v-f755-9qrg.

ai_hunk_gate.reason: No explicit AI marker on the atomic commit that created JSONHeroPath(operation.key).set. Squash 34f8bd588 and PR #1563 members including cf80a02d are unmarked Eric Allam commits.

topology_gate.reason: Single-parent intro squash 34f8bd588 parent 4243cb24. PR #1563 members retrieved. Fix squash 6997aeb parent cc748422. Proto member 0c2d9ce is a PR-branch commit, not an ancestor of the squash; Claude trailers on sibling #4316 members are not transferred onto 34f8bd588 or 0c2d9ce.

but_for_gate.reason: Removing 34f8bd588/cf80a02d removes the sink; those commits are unmarked. Removing Claude-marked sibling security fixes leaves the JSONHeroPath setter intact.

fix_reversal_gate.reason: Released squash 6997aeb adds isSafeMetadataKey(operation.key) before JSONHeroPath.set, reversing the prototype-pollution invariant named by the advisory. That closer is human-authored.

release_gate.reason: First-party patched_versions '>= 4.5.6' vs vulnerable '<= 4.5.5'. Tag v4.5.5 contains intro squash and lacks isSafeMetadataKey. Tag v4.5.6 contains fix squash 6997aeb and the guard. Official introduced 3.3.8 is early (core@3.3.8 lacks operations.ts; core@3.3.9 contains it) but is not a same-version vulnerable/patched contradiction.

uniqueness_gate.reason: Absent from the 212 leader-declared IDs and aliases, including CVE-2026-73654. Not a parent-tail +11 identity. Not counted.

patch_delta.reason: Not an incomplete-remediation row. Contribution class is unmarked introducing JSONHeroPath.set. Direct/contributor but-for is unchanged.
